Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in League City, Texas, when the collsiion occurred. Driver
1 reported that the vehicle was struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 2
gave a statement consistent with that account. Two independent witnesses at the scene and photographs taken by
responding officers support the sequence of events as described by both drivers. The damage to the front driver's
side of Driver 1's vehicle and the rear passenger side of Driver 2's vehicle is consistent with the reported angle and
force of impact. Officers confirmed that a Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the crash, and the
Passenger was identified at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No
prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury and was transported for
evaluation. At this time it is not yet clear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision, and that question will
require medical review.
